name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v550: fixes Cloudflare WebView not appearing on TV when toggle is off. (1) probeAndResolveIfNeeded now always triggers the bypass WebView when no saved cookie exists — previously it failed open and never showed Cloudflare on first launch, leaving TV users with no way to solve. (2) All v549 fixes retained: headless solver loads challenge page exactly once, 15-char clearance token, one-solve-at-a-time, TV invisible→visible fallback, D-pad cursor bounds, safe teardown with no overlap, per-host cookie read/save, per-domain settings rows, client hints, empty-UA guard, host-aware solving. Works for both invisible (toggle ON) and visible (toggle OFF) modes on phone and TV.
